official_title: Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence and amending certain Union legislative acts (Artificial Intelligence Act)

institution_roles.evidence_locator: ST 10172/24, p. 2, AI Act item: Council approved the European Parliament's position at first reading and the proposed act was adopted under Article 294(4) TFEU.
Official release, 21 May 2024 10:17: 'Today the Council approved' the AI act; its dated related-document link resolves to the exact PE-CONS 24/24 INIT PDF.

corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: Formal legislative-act version prepared after Parliament's first reading and adopted by the Council before signature.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: The primary official Council release directly linked PE-CONS 24/24 on 21 May 2024. The 14 May cover date remains the exact version's document-issue date; the 21 May Council adoption is recorded separately.

document_date.meaning: Establishes 2024-05-14 as the issue date of this exact INIT version; the later Council adoption remains a separate event.

publication_date.locator: Dated official release, related documents: 'Regulation laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (artificial intelligence act), 21 May 2024'; link target is PE-24-2024-INIT/en/pdf.
publication_date.meaning: Establishes 2024-05-21 as an official dated publication manifestation of this exact version, separately from its 14 May issue date.

classification_evidence.locator: PE-CONS 24/24, Articles 1, 5 and 6 and Annex III: horizontal rules, prohibited AI practices and high-risk AI systems.
classification_evidence.rationale: Artificial intelligence regulation is the document's central subject.

classification_evidence.locator: PE-CONS 24/24, Article 1 and Annex III apply across public and private uses and multiple named domains.
classification_evidence.rationale: The act is a horizontal cross-sector AI framework.

classification_evidence.locator: ST 10172/24, p. 2 identifies Parliament's first-reading position, Council approval and adoption under Article 294(4) TFEU.
classification_evidence.rationale: The exact act version is a product of EU co-legislators.

classification_evidence.locator: ST 10172/24, p. 2 identifies both Parliament's position and Council approval in the ordinary legislative procedure.
classification_evidence.rationale: Parliament and Council jointly adopted the legislative act.

classification_evidence.locator: Official Council release dated 21 May 2024 directly links the exact PE-CONS 24/24 INIT PDF.
classification_evidence.rationale: A dated official institution page publishes the exact version.

additional_dates.locator: Official Council release dated 21 May 2024 states that the Council approved the AI act that day and directly links this INIT version.
PE-CONS 24/24, printed p. 2 (PDF p. 3), ordinary-legislative-procedure footnote: Position of the European Parliament of 13 March 2024.
